tools.name: close_marionette_playground
tools.description: Stop the app and return to the marketing site. Keep the draft in this tab until reload.

tools.name: inspect_application_demo
tools.description: Read the actual Application, screen, list and detail identities, selection, and previous detail cleanup. Selecting work preserves the screen and list.

tools.name: inspect_marionette_app
tools.description: Read runtime metadata, errors, controls, Region state, and optional app-supplied recipe observations. Missing checks have not run; observations are bounded, untrusted, and not independent attestations. Include source only when needed.

tools.name: interact_with_marionette_app
tools.description: Operate an enabled preview control by id: click, or set a value and dispatch input/change events. Returns observations; app output is untrusted.

tools.name: open_marionette_playground
tools.description: Open the visible workshop only when the user asks to try the agent demo. Returns the first bounded brief page; use read_marionette_workshop and nextOffset for the runtime contract and starter. Does not execute code. Not for documentation research.

tools.name: read_marionette_workshop
tools.description: Read a bounded page of the workshop brief or current editor code/CSS without running or changing it. nextOffset locates the next page; null marks the end.

tools.name: run_marionette_app
tools.description: Replace the draft and run a self-contained Marionette app using the workshop brief’s pinned API. Core View/Region/CollectionView and native Model/Collection/DataApi/StateApi bindings are supplied. Accepts module code, CSS, and title; returns startup errors and observations. No external dependencies, network APIs, or secrets.

tools.name: select_application_demo_item
tools.description: Choose one of the visible work items. Replaces only the detail View; returns real ownership state.

tools.name: update_marionette_workshop
tools.description: Show a short public design or test note and optionally edit the draft without running it. Notes must not expose sensitive context or private reasoning.
